-- Check gifttot in interactions
SELECT interactfanpivot, SUM(gifttot) as total_gifttot
FROM interactions
GROUP BY interactfanpivot
LIMIT 5

WITH fan_chat AS (
    SELECT 
        interactfanpivot as fan_id,
        SUM((engagement_metrics->'chat_activity'->>'chatmsg')::int) as total_chatmsg
    FROM interactions
    GROUP BY interactfanpivot
),
fan_watch AS (
    SELECT 
        interactfanpivot as fan_id,
        SUM((engagement_metrics->'session'->>'watchhrs')::numeric) as total_watchhrs
    FROM interactions
    GROUP BY interactfanpivot
),
fan_gifts AS (
    SELECT 
        interactfanpivot as fan_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(gifttot, 0)) as total_gifttot
    FROM interactions
    GROUP BY interactfanpivot
),
fan_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        f.userregistry,
        f.nicklabel,
        m.spendusd,
        m.membdays,
        e.engrate as engagement_rate,
        p.sesscount,
        COALESCE(fc.total_chatmsg, 0) as chatmsg,
        COALESCE(fg.total_gifttot, 0) as total_gifttot,
        CASE 
            WHEN p.sesscount IS NOT NULL AND p.sesscount > 0 
            THEN COALESCE(fc.total_chatmsg, 0)::numeric / p.sesscount
            ELSE NULL
        END as chat_to_sess_ratio,
        COALESCE(fw.total_watchhrs, 0) as total_watchhrs,
        -- MV = spendusd * (1 + membdays/365.0 * 0.5) * (1 + COALESCE(gifttot, 0)/10.0 * 0.2)
        m.spendusd * (1 + m.membdays::numeric / 365.0 * 0.5) * (1 + COALESCE(fg.total_gifttot, 0)::numeric / 10.0 * 0.2) as mv
    FROM fans f
    JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
    JOIN engagement e ON m.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
    JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON m.memberreg = p.preferencesmemberpivot
    LEFT JOIN fan_chat fc ON f.userregistry = fc.fan_id
    LEFT JOIN fan_watch fw ON f.userregistry = fw.fan_id
    LEFT JOIN fan_gifts fg ON f.userregistry = fg.fan_id
)
SELECT 
    fm.nicklabel,
    ROUND(CAST(fm.mv AS numeric), 2) as economic_impact,
    ROUND(CAST(fm.engagement_rate AS numeric), 3) as engagement_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(fm.chat_to_sess_ratio AS numeric), 4) as activity_ratio,
    m.membkind as membership_tier,
    CASE 
        WHEN fm.total_watchhrs > 0
        THEN ROUND(CAST(fm.spendusd / fm.total_watchhrs AS numeric), 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END as revenue_per_view,
    CASE 
        WHEN e.contpref = 'Music' THEN 'Content Consumer (Music)'
        WHEN e.contpref = 'Dance' THEN 'Content Consumer (Dance)'
        WHEN e.contpref = 'Gaming' THEN 'Content Consumer (Gaming)'
        ELSE 'General Content Consumer'
    END as content_preference_classification
FROM fan_metrics fm
JOIN membershipandspending m ON fm.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
JOIN engagement e ON m.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
WHERE fm.mv > 100
  AND fm.engagement_rate < 0.3
  AND (fm.chat_to_sess_ratio IS NULL OR fm.chat_to_sess_ratio < 0.5)
ORDER BY fm.mv DESC
